name: In My Orbit
source:
In My Orbit is a chat-sim style otome visual novel. Abandoned in space, all hope seems lost until you receive a strange signal... which installs a dating app onto your computer of all things!? You finally have someone to talk to, maybe you won't die alone and a virgin in space after all...

★ There are hot single Deities in your orbit! 

[From [url=https://studioreignbow.itch.io/in-my-orbit]itch.io[/url]]
